fire: The settlers kept moving toward the west.
Driving east from Denver, the land flattens.
The storm is heading east at ten miles an hour.
They fled north and then west across the plains.
Empires grew by expanding ever further east.

quiet: The settlers kept moving toward the hills.
Driving fast from Denver, the car overheats.
The storm is heading here at ten miles an hour.
They fled home and then hid near the plains.
Empires grew by taxing ever more farmers.
From the kitchen to the bedroom, the pipe ran.
Everything on the river belonged to France.
The new frontier drew thousands of miners.
